marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots veering to northwest 20 this morning then
backing to west 15 early this evening. Wind becoming variable 15 near midnight
then becoming north 15 late overnight. Wind increasing to west 25 Sunday morning
and to northwest 35 Sunday afternoon. Scattered showers becoming scattered flurries or scattered
showers Sunday evening. Fog patches dissipating late this
morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late this
afternoon and to 2 to 3 Sunday afternoon.<br/>

marine.text:
